note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors; nominations were received on 20 April 1927 and Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 1 June 1927. Aughnacloy Urban had two nominations, Mr. F. W. Malley (U.), the council's deputy vice-chairman, and Mr. R. Vance (Ind.) (Northern Whig and Belfast Post, 21 April 1927, p. 7). Mr. Malley's nomination failed because his papers were not lodged with the returning officer personally or by his proposer or seconder, and he 'has given a walk-over' to Mr. Richard Vance, chairman of Aughnacloy Town Council (the Town Commissioners), who stood as an Independent (Northern Whig, 30 April 1927, p. 8; Northern Whig and Belfast Post, 25 April 1927, p. 8). The division was not polled. Returned unopposed.
